text: Assumption: The Dcm shall prevent concurrent calls by sequential control — is this correct?

norm: the dcm shall prevent concurrent calls by sequential control
assumption: The Dcm shall prevent concurrent calls by sequential control.
rationale: The interface is specified as non-reentrant without the Dem defining an internal synchronization mechanism.

original.text: Annahme: Das Dcm muss nebenläufige Aufrufe durch sequentielle Steuerung verhindern — trifft das zu?
